section_path: Paraurethral Gland, Overlapping Lesion of Urinary Organs, and Unspecified Urinary Organs
text:
C681  Paraurethral gland
C688  Overlapping lesion of urinary organs
C689  Urinary system, NOS

**Note 1:**  Transitional cell carcinoma (8120-8130) of the prostatic ducts and prostatic urethra are to be coded to urethra (C680) and Summary Stage according to that schema.

**Note 2:** TNM is not defined for this schema. If directly assigning Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000), use the *Urethra, Paraurethral Gland, and Unspecified Urinary Organs* chapter on page 254 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=254).
